prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: uart-tx-div
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 637681f8bf2ee3d5
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback with divider 64 sent 0xa5 but UART RX got 0xff (idle) vs expected 0xa5. TX bit-period test `send_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4)` in excerpt divides the divider by 16, so TX shifts ~16x too fast and returns to idle before RX samples. RX therefore samples all-ones.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 637681f8bf2ee3d5 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
